title: Support Worker Complex Needs
description:
Support Worker Complex Needs Newcastle

£14.50 per hour Permanent hours per week

RTC Resources is recruiting experienced Support Workers on behalf of a specialist care provider in Newcastle.

This role involves supporting individuals with complex needs and behaviours that challenge. You will work within a coordinated team, which may include 3:1, 4:1 or 5:1 staffing, helping people feel safe, build positive relationships and participate in everyday life.

Your responsibilities
- Deliver person-centred support in line with care plans, risk assessments and Positive Behaviour Support plans.
- Recognise triggers and use de-escalation strategies to reduce distress.
- Support personal care, daily routines, meals, medication and community activities as required.
- Maintain accurate records and report safeguarding concerns or changes in needs.
- Work closely with colleagues, families and clinical professionals.
- Prioritise least restrictive practice, with physical intervention used only as a last resort within authorised arrangements and current training.

What we re looking for
- Previous UK experience supporting people with complex needs and behaviours that challenge.
- Experience of 3:1, 4:1 or 5:1 support, or comparable services supporting people with intensive needs.
- Practical experience managing behavioural escalation and physical aggression.
- Strong communication, teamwork and de-escalation skills.
- An understanding of safeguarding and professional boundaries.

DMI/Dynamis training is highly desirable. Current or recent PMVA or other recognised physical intervention training may be considered, subject to review and completion of required training and competency assessments.

Benefits

Paid annual leave, pension contributions, free in-house DMI and mandatory training, and ongoing development opportunities.

Applicants must have UK care/support experience and the right to work in the UK. Sponsorship is not available for this role.

Apply with your CV to RTC Resources, including your relevant experience.

title: Support Worker
description:
Cerise Healthcare are seeking Support Workers to work with our client, suppliers of support to Adults with Learning Disabilities based at their services across Sunderland, Tyne & Wear

Benefits for Support Workers choosing to work with Cerise Healthcare include:
- Competitive rates of pay
- Flexible working hours to suit you

The roles available are for Support Workers who will be offering care to individuals in supported living services. Support Workers may be assigned key worker or floating support roles within the services and should be aware that there may be some lone working

Tasks Support Workers may be expected to undertake include:
- Personal care (dependent on the requirements of those living at the service)
- Medication administration/prompting
- Assistance with finances
- Community access

- Enabling an independent lifestyle

Cerise Healthcare are happy to consider applications for Support Workers looking for full and part time roles. There are a mixture of early, late and long days available at these services.

Cerise Healthcare require all Support Workers to:
- Be able to work under their own initiative
- Be compassionate and understanding

Please note that these roles are subject to a successful DBS, reference checks and passing mandatory training

title: Care Assistants
company: North Haven Care and Support Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Job Title: Care Assistants

Location: South Shields, South Tyneside

Salary: 14.44 - 14.94 per hour + 35p per mile for driving roles

Job Type: Permanent - Full Time, Part Time or Casual (guaranteed hours available)

No care experience? No problem. We'll give you full paid training, two paid shadow shifts and a fully funded Social Care diploma, so all you need to bring is a passion for helping others.

About us:

North Haven Care and Support Ltd is a Good CQC rated home care provider across South Tyneside and Sunderland. We help people with a wide range of conditions stay independent, stay in control of their own lives and stay in the homes they love.

About the role:

As a Care Assistant, you'll visit clients in their own homes and out in the local community, helping them live well and keeping their pride and dignity. No two days are the same. You'll help with:
- Personal care
- Preparing meals
- Administering medicine
- Shopping and household tasks

We have a number of positions available and are recruiting for two types of role:
- Driving carers (3-4 roles): you'll need a full licence and access to a vehicle, with mileage paid at 35p per mile
- Walking carers (2-3 roles): no licence needed, as you'll cover clients within walking distance of each other

Shifts: Earlies (7am-3pm) and/or lates (3pm-11pm) on a rota, with some weekends. Choose the hours that fit around childcare, study or other commitments.

Areas covered: Marsden, Whitburn, Cleadon, The Nook, Simonside, West Harton, Brockley Whins, Westoe, West Park and Tyne Dock.

About you:
- You're caring, compassionate and a good listener
- You enjoy building relationships with a diverse range of individuals
- You can drive and have access to a vehicle (preferred)
- Experience is welcome but not required. Experienced carers with an up-to-date DBS check can start quickly

What we offer:
- Up to 14.94 per hour, plus 35p per mile for driving roles
- 28 days' annual leave (pro rata)
- Paid classroom training and paid shadow shifts
- Fully funded QCF diploma in Social Care and a clear route to progress
- Flexible hours and guaranteed hours contracts
- Pension scheme
- Free on-site parking
- Referral programme

Additional Information:

All successful candidates will need an enhanced DBS check.

If this sounds like the ideal opportunity for you just click on the APPLY button, we look forward to hearing from you!

Candidates with experience of; Care Assistant, Carer, Home Carer, Care Worker, Domiciliary Care Worker, Domiciliary Carer, Support Worker, Community Care Worker, Healthcare Assistant, Personal Care Assistant, Home Care Assistant, Social Care Worker will also be considered for this role.

title: Care Support Worker
description:
SHC(phone number removed)

Care Support Worker

Durham, Beddell House Care Home

Salary: 13.52 per hour

Full and Part Time Opportunities Available

The role of the Care Support Worker is to provide care in accordance with best practice and legislative requirements, reflecting policies and procedures and agreed standards under the direction of the Senior Care Worker.

The Care Support Worker will support and enable residents to maintain skills and personal interests while delivering person-centred care unique to everyone. In order to do this, a commitment to maintaining own skills at a required level is needed with a willingness to undertake such training and development as required, from time-to-time, to maintain and progress knowledge.

Role-specific Duties:

Care Support Worker responsibilities include but are not limited to the following:
- Provide respectful, person-centered care, ensuring that residents are at the heart of care delivery, and their wishes and preferences are taken into consideration to enhance their wellbeing.
- Support residents to maintain their relationships and connections with the local community.
- Assist with daily living activities such as bathing, dressing, grooming and mobility support.
- Be responsible for promoting and safeguarding the welfare of those individuals they support.
- Administration of medication to residents and accurate record-keeping, in line with policy and procedure.
- Any other reasonable request that supports the needs of our residents and the needs of the organisation.

The vacancy may close earlier than the advertised closing date if high volume of suitable applications are received. Please submit application as early as possible to avoid disappointment.

title: Health Care Assistant
company: Atlas Care Homes Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
We are seeking a compassionate and dedicated Healthcare Assistant to join our team at Rosewood House. The successful candidate will provide essential support to patients and residents within care homes and home care settings. This role involves assisting with daily activities, ensuring the well-being of individuals, and supporting the delivery of personalised care plans. The position offers an opportunity to make a meaningful difference in people's lives while working within a professional and caring environment.

Responsibilities

Assist patients and residents with personal care tasks such as bathing, dressing, and mobility.

Support individuals with their daily routines, including meal preparation and medication reminders.

Maintain accurate records of care provided in accordance with care plans.

Communicate effectively with patients, families, and healthcare professionals to ensure high standards of care.

Drive between different care settings or appointments as required, ensuring timely attendance.

Assist with light domestic duties to promote a clean and safe environment.

Follow all health and safety protocols to ensure the safety of both patients and staff.

Participate in ongoing training programmes to stay updated on best practices in healthcare assistance.

title: Residential Support Worker
description:
We are working in partnership with a provider of children s services and have a permanent opportunity for a Residential Children's Worker based in Northumberland. If successful, you will be working as part of a team providing support to children with social, emotional, and behavioural difficulties within a children's home. This is an opportunity to join a supportive employer with genuine opportunities to progress.

This is a permanent position working 40 hours per week plus sleep-ins. Previous experience is not essential, so if you are looking to start your career as a Residential Children s Worker, our client can promise a nurturing, supportive and fun working environment. If you are already an established Residential Children s Worker, our client may be able to offer progression into a Senior Role as and when the time is right.

Alongside countless benefits and progression opportunities, our client is paying between £12.50 - £13.50 plus sleep-ins.

As a Residential Children's Worker your responsibilities will include:
- Provide support using a person centred approach.
- Support the children to maintain and develop relationships with friends and family.
- Encourage the children to integrate with the local community by attending clubs or day centres.
- Support the children in all aspects of their daily living.
- Safeguard vulnerable children and report any suspicion or evidence of harm.
- Continuous commitment to professional development.
- To be willing to cover other homes when required.
- Liaise with parents and/or carers and other professionals.

Our client is offering a whole range of benefits, including:
- Overtime opportunities.
- Company car.
- Progression opportunities.
- Paid enrolment onto Level 3.

To take the next step in your career, apply today for a conversation with our Residential specialist Tom Lane.

Not for you? Refer your friends and family and as our way of saying thank you, we will give you a referral bonus.
